name: CoinTelegraph
rootCause: According to monitoring by Scam Sniffer, the front end of CoinTelegraph has been hacked—exercise caution. Reportedly, clicking the CoinTelegraph website triggers a pop-up containing “airdrop” information that cannot be closed within the page.
